name: dependency-upgrade-orchestration
description: Scan polyglot dependencies, plan upgrades ask-first, optionally dedupe remote work and research migrations, then upgrade, validate, fix, and ship on a feature branch.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: all, security-only, patch-minor, or major-allowed. Defaults to patch-minor when omitted.

inputs.name: ecosystems
inputs.description: Optional comma list to limit ecosystem scan.

inputs.name: allow-web-research
inputs.description: When true, run upgrade-migration-researcher for major bumps.

inputs.name: enable-github
inputs.description: When true, run remote-upgrade-tracker GitHub leg when gh works.

inputs.name: enable-gitlab
inputs.description: When true, run remote-upgrade-tracker GitLab leg when available.

inputs.name: dry-run
inputs.description: When true in execute phase, validate and fix without commit or push. Recommended true for first execute pass.

inputs.name: approved-plan
inputs.description: Optional prior upgrade-plan markdown to resume; re-confirm approval if inventory drifted.

inputs.name: custom-instructions
inputs.description: Pins, skips, monorepo roots, or execution notes.

outputs.name: remote-collision-report
outputs.description: Remote dedup report or explicit skipped note.

outputs.name: validation-handoff-summary
outputs.description: Final handoff from upgrade-validation-fixer when execute ran.
